title: VenomLink: snakebite care, mapped
caption: Lahore / an explorable geospatial prototype
speech: A snake encounter raises two questions: what might this snake be, and how can I explore nearby care? VenomLink brings on-device species suggestions and an interactive hospital map together for Lahore. This walkthrough uses actual screenshots from the working application.

title: A photo. A closer look.
caption: Real browser inference / photos stay on your device
speech: Choose a snake photograph and run the supplied Snake Teller classifier directly in your browser. The trained model was exported to ONNX and provides possible species matches. The separate foliage detector is excluded. A prediction is not a diagnosis or a determination of venom, safety, or treatment.

title: Real places, visible on a map
caption: 11 independent records / source-linked coordinates
speech: The map starts with eleven independent facility records, including ten hospital candidates and one reference institution. Coordinates come from OpenStreetMap and public Punjab government sources. Python validates the dataset before it is stored in private Amazon S three and delivered through the application API.

title: Compare the journey, not just distance
caption: Traffic-aware Google driving estimates / seven user-listed leads
speech: Select a starting point and compare seven user-listed hospital leads. Google traffic-aware driving estimates provide travel time, distance, and road geometry. The app highlights the quickest returned route. This captured test returned all seven routes, with Mayo Hospital at thirteen minutes. Results change with time and provider availability.

title: Discovery with an honest fallback
caption: Amazon Location discovery / independent saved directory
speech: Amazon Location searches nearby places and names through Lambda and API Gateway. Hospital-category coverage returned no matches in our Lahore tests, so the app also exposes the independent saved directory, clearly separated from AWS results. Ten injections per hospital is simulated demo inventory; real antivenom stock and treatment capability are unverified.

title: Source. Validate. Explore.
caption: React / TypeScript / AWS / ONNX Runtime Web
speech: The stack combines React and TypeScript, Google Maps, and ONNX Runtime Web. The deployed AWS services are S three, Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon Location, Secrets Manager, IAM, and CloudWatch logs. Iceberg and Athena remain optional scripts, not deployed services. Explore the live map and public code to reuse the pattern. Confirm actual care directly with hospitals.
